description: This source file defines the RemoteTunnelManager actor which manages an SSH tunnel for forwarding a remote gateway/control port to localhost. It includes methods to ensure the tunnel is active, reuses existing tunnels when possible, and handles restart logic with backoff to avoid rapid restarts.

classes.name: RemoteTunnelManager
classes.description: An actor that manages an SSH tunnel for remote gateway/control port forwarding, ensuring the tunnel is active and handling restarts with backoff.

methods.name: controlTunnelPortIfRunning
methods.description: Checks if an SSH control tunnel is active and reuses it if possible; otherwise, initiates restart procedures.

methods.name: ensureControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures that an SSH control tunnel is established, creating one if necessary, and returns the local port.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Stops and terminates any active control tunnel.

methods.name: isSshProcess
methods.description: Determines whether a given process descriptor corresponds to an SSH process.

methods.name: beginRestart
methods.description: Initiates a restart of the SSH tunnel with a backoff delay to prevent rapid restarts.

methods.name: endRestart
methods.description: Marks the end of a restart process.

methods.name: waitForRestartBackoffIfNeeded
methods.description: Waits for the backoff duration if a restart was recently attempted.
